title: Gnss-denied unmanned aerial vehicle navigation: analyzing computational complexity, sensor fusion, and localization methodologies
authors: Jarraya I.; Al-Batati A.; Kadri M.B.; Abdelkader M.; Ammar A.; Boulila W.; Koubaa A.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
